Exercise: One-Arm Side Deadlift

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
expert

Movement Patterns:

- unilateral_hip_hinge

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:

- abdominals
- calves
- glutes
- hamstrings
- lower back
- traps

Equipment:

- barbell

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- hypertrophy
- strengthening_the_core_and_lower_body

Contraindications:

- Lower back issues
- Shoulder injuries

Exercise Variations:

- name: One-Arm Side Deadlift with Pause, instructions: ['Perform the One-Arm Side Deadlift as described.', 'Pause at the top of the movement for a count of two.']
- name: One-Arm Side Deadlift with Band Resistance, equipment: resistance band

Substitution Options:

- name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Deadlift, equipment: dumbbells
- name: Kettlebell Swing, equipment: kettlebell

Instructions:

- Stand to the side of a barbell next to its center. Bend your knees and lower your body until you are able to reach the barbell.
- Grasp the bar as if you were grabbing a briefcase (palms facing you since the bar is sideways). You may need a wrist wrap if you are using a significant amount of weight. This is your starting position.
- Use your legs to help lift the barbell up while exhaling. Your arms should extend fully as bring the barbell up until you are in a standing position.
- Slowly bring the barbell back down while inhaling. Tip: Make sure to bend your knees while lowering the weight to avoid any injury from occurring.
- Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
- Switch arms and repeat the movement.
